newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Jailed Albanian Socialist transferred to Tirana.
newsitem.headline: Jailed Albanian Socialist transferred to Tirana.

text.p: Albania's jailed opposition Socialist leader Fatos Nano was transferred from a prison in southern Albania last week and brought to Tirana, a justice ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
"He was transferred last week by road from Tepelene and is now in a prison in Tirana. He is in good health," the spokesman said.
Fighting broke out among inmates of the Tepelene prison around February 23.The disturbances were contained but the general-director of prisons decided to move Nano to Tirana, the spokesman said.
Nano, who served a short term as prime minister in 1991, was arrested in 1993 and jailed a year later on charges of corruption relating to an Italian aid scandal.
International human rights groups have called on the Albanian government to free Nano, who they say was wrongly convicted.
Armed rebels were reported to have taken control of Tepelene in an insurrection in the sout and a reporter said on Thursday insurgents had rolled out artillery into the main square
